workplace-safety.name: OSHA 10-Hour Construction
workplace-safety.blurb: Ten-hour entry-level outreach course covering the Focus Four hazards, required on many construction sites and by several states.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 30-Hour Construction
workplace-safety.blurb: Supervisor-level outreach training covering hazard recognition, OSHA standards and site safety management responsibilities.

workplace-safety.name: Aerial Lift and MEWP Operator Certification
workplace-safety.blurb: Operator qualification covering mobile elevating work platform inspection, fall protection and safe positioning under ANSI A92 standards.

workplace-safety.name: Bloodborne Pathogens Awareness Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Annual training on exposure control plans, universal precautions and post-exposure procedures required for at-risk employees.

workplace-safety.name: Permit-Required Confined Space Entry Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training for entrants, attendants and entry supervisors covering atmospheric testing, permits, ventilation and rescue arrangements.

workplace-safety.name: DOT Hazmat Employee Training

workplace-safety.name: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations Function-Specific Training

workplace-safety.name: Excavation and Trenching Competent Person Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Competent person training on soil classification, protective systems, access and daily inspection of excavations and trenches.

workplace-safety.name: Fall Protection Competent Person Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Competent person training on fall hazard identification, anchorage selection, harness inspection and rescue planning at height.

workplace-safety.name: Powered Industrial Truck (Forklift) Operator Certification
workplace-safety.blurb: Formal instruction, practical evaluation and three-yearly re-evaluation required before an employee may operate a powered industrial truck.

workplace-safety.name: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Awareness Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training for oil, gas and wastewater workers on hydrogen sulfide properties, detection, respiratory protection and rescue procedures.

workplace-safety.name: Hazard Communication and GHS Training

workplace-safety.name: Hazardous Materials First Responder Awareness Level Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Awareness-level training for personnel likely to discover a hazardous substance release and required to notify emergency responders.

workplace-safety.name: Hazardous Materials First Responder Operations Level Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Eight-hour operations-level training for responders taking defensive action to contain a hazardous substance release from a safe distance.

workplace-safety.name: Hazardous Materials Technician Level Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Twenty-four hour minimum training for responders who take offensive action to plug, patch or stop a hazardous materials release.

workplace-safety.name: HAZWOPER 24-Hour Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training for occasional site workers and visitors unlikely to be exposed above permissible limits on hazardous waste sites.

workplace-safety.name: HAZWOPER 40-Hour Training

workplace-safety.name: HAZWOPER 8-Hour Annual Refresher

workplace-safety.name: HAZWOPER 8-Hour Supervisor Training

workplace-safety.name: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Category-based training required every 24 months for shippers and freight staff preparing dangerous goods for carriage by air.

workplace-safety.name: IMDG Code Dangerous Goods Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training on classification, packing, segregation and documentation for shipping dangerous goods by sea under the IMDG Code.

workplace-safety.name: Lead Awareness Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Awareness training on lead exposure routes, permissible exposure limits, hygiene facilities and medical surveillance requirements.

workplace-safety.name: Lockout/Tagout Authorized Employee Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training for authorised employees on energy-isolating devices, machine-specific procedures and periodic inspection of energy control.

workplace-safety.name: NFPA 70E Electrical Safety in the Workplace Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Qualified person training on arc flash boundaries, incident energy analysis, PPE categories and energised work permits.

workplace-safety.name: Process Safety Management Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training on the fourteen PSM elements including process hazard analysis, mechanical integrity and management of change.

workplace-safety.name: RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Annual training for large-quantity generator personnel on waste determination, accumulation, manifesting and contingency planning.

workplace-safety.name: Respirator Fit Test Administrator Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Training for personnel administering qualitative and quantitative respirator fit tests and managing written respiratory protection programmes.

workplace-safety.name: Scaffold Competent Person Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Competent person training on scaffold erection, capacity, fall protection and pre-shift inspection of supported and suspended scaffolds.

workplace-safety.name: Respirable Crystalline Silica Competent Person Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Competent person training on Table 1 control methods, exposure assessment and written exposure control plans for silica dust.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Outreach Training

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 10-Hour Maritime Industry Outreach Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Ten-hour Outreach course for shipyard, marine terminal and longshoring workers covering hazards under 29 CFR Parts 1915, 1917 and 1918.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 30-Hour General Industry Outreach Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Thirty-hour Outreach course for supervisors and safety staff covering general industry standards, programme management and recordkeeping.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 30-Hour Maritime Industry Outreach Training
workplace-safety.blurb: Thirty-hour Outreach course for maritime supervisors covering shipyard employment, marine terminals and longshoring safety standards.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 500 Trainer Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Construction Industry
workplace-safety.blurb: Authorisation course allowing safety professionals to deliver 10-hour and 30-hour construction Outreach classes and issue DOL cards.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 501 Trainer Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for General Industry
workplace-safety.blurb: Authorisation course allowing safety professionals to deliver 10-hour and 30-hour general industry Outreach classes and issue DOL cards.

workplace-safety.blurb: Four-yearly update course required for authorised construction Outreach trainers to maintain their trainer status.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 503 Update for General Industry Outreach Trainers
workplace-safety.blurb: Four-yearly update course required for authorised general industry Outreach trainers to maintain their trainer status.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 511 Occupational Safety and Health Standards for General Industry
workplace-safety.blurb: Prerequisite course covering 29 CFR 1910 general industry standards for candidates preparing to take the OSHA 501 trainer course.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 521 Guide to Industrial Hygiene

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 2015 Hazardous Materials

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 2045 Machinery and Machine Guarding Standards

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 2055 Cranes in Construction
workplace-safety.blurb: Course on 29 CFR 1926 Subpart CC crane requirements including assembly, operator qualification, signalling and power-line safety.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 2225 Respiratory Protection
workplace-safety.blurb: Course on building a written respiratory protection programme, respirator selection, fit testing and medical evaluation.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 2255 Principles of Ergonomics
workplace-safety.blurb: Course on recognising musculoskeletal risk factors and applying engineering and administrative controls to reduce workplace strain.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 2264 Permit-Required Confined Space Entry
workplace-safety.blurb: Course covering permit space programmes, atmospheric testing instruments, ventilation and non-entry rescue techniques.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 3015 Excavation, Trenching and Soil Mechanics
workplace-safety.blurb: Course on soil classification, sloping, shoring and shielding systems used to protect workers in excavations and trenches.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 3085 Principles of Scaffolding
workplace-safety.blurb: Course covering scaffold types, load capacities, erection and dismantling procedures and Subpart L inspection requirements.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 3095 Electrical Standards
workplace-safety.blurb: Course on OSHA electrical standards, hazard analysis, grounding, wiring methods and safety-related work practices.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 3115 Fall Protection
workplace-safety.blurb: Course on fall hazard recognition, guardrail and net systems, personal fall arrest components and rescue planning.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 5400 Trainer Course in Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Maritime Industry
workplace-safety.blurb: Authorisation course allowing instructors to deliver 10-hour and 30-hour maritime Outreach classes and issue DOL completion cards.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 5402 Update for Maritime Industry Outreach Trainers
workplace-safety.blurb: Four-yearly update course required for authorised maritime Outreach trainers to retain trainer authorisation.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 5410 Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Maritime Industry
workplace-safety.blurb: Prerequisite course covering shipyard, marine terminal and longshoring standards for candidates entering the OSHA 5400 trainer course.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 5600 Disaster Site Worker Trainer Course
workplace-safety.blurb: Authorisation course for instructors delivering the Disaster Site Worker Outreach programme to skilled support personnel.

workplace-safety.name: OSHA 5602 Update for Disaster Site Worker Trainers

workplace-safety.blurb: Short course on writing exposure control plans and selecting engineering controls for healthcare bloodborne pathogen hazards.

workplace-safety.name: Certified Instructional Trainer

workplace-safety.name: Certified Occupational Safety Manager
workplace-safety.blurb: Management-level safety certification covering programme development, leadership, regulatory compliance and performance measurement.

workplace-safety.name: Certified Occupational Safety Specialist
workplace-safety.blurb: Multi-day course and examination on OSHA general industry and construction standards for site-level safety specialists.

workplace-safety.name: Certified Safety and Health Manager
workplace-safety.blurb: Certification for safety managers covering programme leadership, risk assessment, regulatory compliance and business integration.

workplace-safety.name: Certified Safety and Health Official
workplace-safety.blurb: Certificate awarded by OTI Education Centers after a defined series of OSHA numbered courses in construction or general industry.

workplace-safety.name: Certified Safety Director
workplace-safety.blurb: Certification for directors accountable for corporate safety strategy, budgeting, auditing and regulatory relationships.

workplace-safety.name: Certified Safety Manager
workplace-safety.blurb: Certification covering OSHA compliance, hazard analysis and safety programme administration for workplace safety managers.

workplace-safety.blurb: Senior BCPE certification for ergonomists with graduate education and documented practice in workplace and product design.

workplace-safety.name: Safety Trained Supervisor

workplace-safety.name: Safety Trained Supervisor Construction

aviation-maritime.blurb: 40-question test on balloon systems, launch site assessment and sport pilot privileges for lighter-than-air balloon pilots.

aviation-maritime.name: Sport Pilot Powered Parachute Knowledge Test
aviation-maritime.blurb: 40-question test on powered parachute operation, canopy inflation, surface wind limits and sport pilot regulations.

aviation-maritime.name: Sport Pilot Weight-Shift-Control Knowledge Test
aviation-maritime.blurb: 40-question test on weight-shift-control trike operation and sport pilot limitations on airspace, altitude and passengers.

aviation-maritime.name: The Recreational UAS Safety Test
aviation-maritime.blurb: Free online safety test that every recreational drone flyer in the United States must pass and carry proof of completion.

aviation-maritime.name: Unmanned Aircraft General Small Knowledge Test
aviation-maritime.blurb: 60-question test on airspace, weather, loading and drone regulations required for the Part 107 remote pilot certificate.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Diesel Engines Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Marine technician certification on diesel propulsion installation, fuel systems, cooling, exhaust and troubleshooting to ABYC standards.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Gasoline Engines Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification on inboard and sterndrive gasoline engine service, ignition protection, ventilation and fuel system standards.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Marine Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification covering marine chilled water and direct expansion systems, seawater cooling, refrigerants and onboard installation practice.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Marine Corrosion Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification on galvanic and stray current corrosion, bonding systems, anodes and cathodic protection surveys for boats.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Marine Electrical Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Widely held marine technician certification covering AC and DC systems, shore power, bonding and ABYC E-11 wiring standards.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Marine Systems Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification spanning steering, fuel, plumbing, ventilation, LPG and other onboard systems assessed against ABYC standards.

aviation-maritime.name: ABYC Standards Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification demonstrating working knowledge of the full ABYC standards manual and federal boat construction regulations.

aviation-maritime.name: Able Seaman Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Deck rating issued in grades from Special to Unlimited, requiring sea service plus an examination in seamanship and safety.

aviation-maritime.name: Able Seafarer-Deck Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: STCW deck rating under Regulation II/5 requiring assessed competencies in navigation watch support, mooring and cargo handling.

aviation-maritime.name: Able Seafarer-Engine Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: STCW engine rating under Regulation III/5 covering watchkeeping support, machinery operation and engine room maintenance tasks.

aviation-maritime.name: American Sailing 101 Basic Keelboat Sailing
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry sailing certification covering points of sail, tacking, gybing, rules of the road and crew overboard recovery on small keelboats.

aviation-maritime.name: American Sailing 103 Basic Coastal Cruising
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification for skippering an auxiliary-powered sailboat of about 25 to 35 feet in moderate coastal conditions by day.

aviation-maritime.name: American Sailing 104 Bareboat Cruising
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification for chartering and skippering a 30 to 45 foot cruising sailboat, including provisioning, anchoring and systems management.

aviation-maritime.name: Apprentice Mate (Steersman) of Towing Vessels
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry towing endorsement requiring 30 days of deck service and an examination before a mariner may begin supervised wheelhouse training.

aviation-maritime.name: Assistance Towing Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Optional endorsement added to an OUPV or Master licence allowing the holder to tow disabled recreational vessels for hire.

aviation-maritime.name: Auxiliary Sail Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Endorsement permitting a licensed operator to work on sail or auxiliary sail vessels after qualifying sea service and an exam module.

aviation-maritime.name: Chief Engineer (Limited) Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Engineering licence for chief engineers on vessels of limited horsepower and tonnage, tested on motor and steam plant operation.

aviation-maritime.name: Chief Mate Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Senior deck licence for vessels of any gross tons, requiring management-level STCW training plus extensive Coast Guard examination modules.

aviation-maritime.name: Company Security Officer Course
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course preparing shoreside personnel to develop and maintain vessel security plans under the ISPS Code and MTSA.

aviation-maritime.name: Designated Duty Engineer Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Engineering licence for sole-engineer vessels, issued in horsepower tiers and requiring exams on diesel plants, electrical and auxiliary systems.

aviation-maritime.name: Facility Security Officer Course
aviation-maritime.blurb: Training required for officers responsible for security plans, drills and access control at MTSA-regulated waterfront facilities.

aviation-maritime.name: First Class Pilot Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Route-specific federal pilotage endorsement earned by round trips over the route and a chart examination drawn from memory.

aviation-maritime.name: Lifeboatman Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Rating endorsement requiring practical assessment in launching and handling survival craft, matched by the STCW proficiency in survival craft.

aviation-maritime.name: Marine Chemist Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification allowing a chemist to issue safe-for-workers and safe-for-hot-work certificates on vessels under NFPA 306.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels 1600 Gross Tons
aviation-maritime.blurb: Deck licence for oceans, near coastal or inland service on vessels up to 1600 gross tons, requiring multi-module Coast Guard examinations.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels 500 Gross Tons
aviation-maritime.blurb: Mid-tier deck licence for vessels up to 500 gross tons covering navigation, stability, cargo handling and rules of the road.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels Any Gross Tons
aviation-maritime.blurb: Highest deck licence authorising command of vessels of unlimited tonnage on oceans, subject to management-level STCW and extensive exams.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 100 GRT
aviation-maritime.blurb: Widely held captain licence for inspected passenger vessels under 100 gross tons, tested on deck general, deck safety, rules and chart plot.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
aviation-maritime.blurb: Deck licence for vessels under 200 gross tons requiring additional sea service and examination beyond the 100 ton master level.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 25 GRT
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry master licence assigned when a mariner qualifying sea service is on vessels of very small tonnage under 46 CFR 11.422.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 50 GRT
aviation-maritime.blurb: Master licence tier assigned from documented tonnage history, authorising command of inspected vessels under 50 gross tons.

aviation-maritime.name: Master of Towing Vessels
aviation-maritime.blurb: Licence to command towing vessels on a specified route, earned through a towing officer assessment record and Coast Guard examination.

aviation-maritime.name: Mate (Pilot) of Towing Vessels
aviation-maritime.blurb: Wheelhouse licence permitting a mariner to stand a navigation watch aboard towing vessels after completing assessed towing competencies.

aviation-maritime.name: Mate of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
aviation-maritime.blurb: Deck licence authorising watchkeeping as mate on inspected vessels under 200 gross tons on inland or near coastal routes.

aviation-maritime.name: Merchant Mariner Credential
aviation-maritime.blurb: Single credential book that consolidates all officer, rating and STCW endorsements a United States mariner holds.

aviation-maritime.name: Merchant Mariner Medical Certificate
aviation-maritime.blurb: Medical and physical fitness certificate required alongside the merchant mariner credential, based on the CG-719K examination.

aviation-maritime.name: NAMS Certified Marine Surveyor
aviation-maritime.blurb: Peer-reviewed surveyor credential requiring documented experience, sample surveys and examination in yachts, cargo or hull and machinery.

aviation-maritime.name: NASBLA-Approved Boating Safety Course
aviation-maritime.blurb: Nationally approved recreational boating course covering navigation rules, required equipment and emergencies, accepted by most states.

aviation-maritime.name: NMEA 2000 Network Installer Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Certification on designing, wiring and troubleshooting NMEA 2000 backbone networks for marine navigation and engine data.

aviation-maritime.name: NMEA Marine Electronics Installer Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Tiered certification for technicians installing radar, chartplotters, autopilots, VHF and interfaced navigation electronics on vessels.

aviation-maritime.name: Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry captain licence allowing carriage of up to six paying passengers on uninspected vessels for inland, Great Lakes or near coastal routes.

aviation-maritime.name: Ordinary Seaman Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry-level deck rating requiring no sea service, used as the starting endorsement for new mariners joining a vessel crew.

aviation-maritime.name: Qualified Member of the Engine Department
aviation-maritime.blurb: Engine rating covering oiler, fireman-watertender, junior engineer and refrigerating engineer roles, earned by sea service and examination.

aviation-maritime.name: Radar Observer (Inland) Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Short course and practical assessment on radar navigation and collision avoidance for inland and river route mariners.

aviation-maritime.name: Radar Observer (Unlimited) Certification
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course covering radar plotting, relative motion, ARPA principles and collision avoidance for unlimited tonnage service.

aviation-maritime.name: Rating Forming Part of an Engineering Watch
aviation-maritime.blurb: STCW engine rating certifying competence to keep an engine room watch under the direction of a licensed engineer officer.

aviation-maritime.name: Rating Forming Part of a Navigational Watch
aviation-maritime.blurb: STCW deck rating requiring assessed steering, lookout and watchkeeping competencies for service on seagoing vessels.

aviation-maritime.name: SAMS Accredited Marine Surveyor
aviation-maritime.blurb: Accreditation for marine surveyors requiring experience, continuing education and an examination on survey practice and standards.

aviation-maritime.name: Second Mate Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Unlimited-tonnage deck licence above third mate, requiring additional sea service and Coast Guard examination modules.

aviation-maritime.name: Ship's Cook Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Steward department endorsement requiring approved food safety training and sea service before a mariner may serve as ship cook.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Advanced Firefighting
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course on shipboard fire command, fixed systems, fire investigation and casualty control required for officer endorsements.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Automatic Radar Plotting Aids
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course on ARPA target acquisition, trial manoeuvres, system limitations and errors for officers in charge of a navigational watch.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Basic Training
aviation-maritime.blurb: Four-module STCW course covering personal survival, basic firefighting, elementary first aid and personal safety and social responsibility.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Bridge Resource Management
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course on bridge teamwork, situational awareness, communication and error management for watchkeeping deck officers.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course on electronic chart systems, route planning, alarms, sensor inputs and ECDIS limitations for navigating officers.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Leadership and Managerial Skills
aviation-maritime.blurb: Management-level STCW course on shipboard leadership, resource management, decision making and workload assessment.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Leadership and Teamwork
aviation-maritime.blurb: Operational-level STCW course on teamwork, task allocation and effective communication aboard vessels for junior officers.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Medical Care Provider
aviation-maritime.blurb: Advanced shipboard medical course covering patient assessment, medication administration and radio medical advice for masters and mates.

aviation-maritime.name: STCW Medical First Aid Provider
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course on immediate care of shipboard casualties including bleeding, burns, fractures, hypothermia and rescue breathing.

aviation-maritime.name: Tankerman-Assistant Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Endorsement allowing a mariner to assist in cargo transfers of oil or hazardous liquids under the supervision of a person in charge.

aviation-maritime.name: Tankerman-Engineer Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Endorsement for licensed engineers supervising transfer of fuel oil and bunkering operations aboard tank vessels.

aviation-maritime.name: Tankerman-PIC Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Endorsement authorising a mariner to act as person in charge of transferring dangerous liquid or liquefied gas cargo.

aviation-maritime.name: Tankerman-PIC (Barge) Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Restricted tankerman endorsement covering cargo transfers on tank barges rather than self-propelled tank vessels.

aviation-maritime.name: Third Assistant Engineer Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry unlimited engineering officer licence requiring extensive Coast Guard examinations in motor, steam, gas turbine and electrical plants.

aviation-maritime.name: Third Mate Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry unlimited deck officer licence for oceans service, examined across navigation, stability, cargo, safety and rules of the road.

aviation-maritime.name: Transportation Worker Identification Credential
aviation-maritime.blurb: Biometric identity card required for unescorted access to secure port areas and for all credentialed merchant mariners.

aviation-maritime.name: USCG Chart Plot Exam Module
aviation-maritime.blurb: Ten-question plotting module requiring 90 percent to pass, covering fixes, set and drift, courses to steer and estimated times of arrival.

aviation-maritime.name: USCG Deck General Exam Module
aviation-maritime.blurb: Examination module on seamanship, marlinespike, ship construction, stability and deck operations for master level credentials.

aviation-maritime.name: USCG Deck Safety Exam Module
aviation-maritime.blurb: Examination module covering firefighting, damage control, lifesaving equipment, pollution regulations and emergency procedures.

aviation-maritime.name: USCG Navigation General Exam Module
aviation-maritime.blurb: Fifty-question module on aids to navigation, tides and currents, compass error, weather and publications, requiring 90 percent to pass.

aviation-maritime.name: USCG Rules of the Road Exam Module
aviation-maritime.blurb: Module on International and Inland navigation rules, lights, shapes and sound signals requiring a 90 percent passing score.

aviation-maritime.name: Vessel Personnel with Designated Security Duties
aviation-maritime.blurb: STCW security training for crew assigned security tasks, covering threat recognition, screening, search and security equipment use.

aviation-maritime.name: Vessel Security Officer Course
aviation-maritime.blurb: Approved course for officers responsible for implementing and maintaining the ship security plan under the ISPS Code.

aviation-maritime.name: Amateur Extra Class License Exam
aviation-maritime.blurb: 50-question examination granting full amateur radio privileges, covering advanced theory, transmission lines and specialised operating rules.

aviation-maritime.name: Amateur Radio General Class License Exam
aviation-maritime.blurb: 35-question examination opening most high-frequency amateur bands, covering propagation, antennas, rules and station operation.

aviation-maritime.name: Amateur Radio Technician Class License Exam
aviation-maritime.blurb: Entry amateur radio examination of 35 questions on regulations, operating practice and electronics for VHF and UHF privileges.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 1 Basic Radio Law and Operating Practice
aviation-maritime.blurb: 24-question examination on radio law and operating practice that underpins the Marine Radio Operator Permit and other commercial licences.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 3 General Radiotelephone
aviation-maritime.blurb: 76-question technical examination on electronics, antennas and transmitters taken with Element 1 to earn the GROL.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 5 Radiotelegraph Operating Practice
aviation-maritime.blurb: Written examination on radiotelegraph operating procedures and regulations required toward the Radiotelegraph Operator License.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 6 Advanced Radiotelegraph
aviation-maritime.blurb: Technical examination on radiotelegraph equipment, installation and maintenance for the commercial radiotelegraph operator licence.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 7 GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
aviation-maritime.blurb: 76-question examination on distress alerting, digital selective calling, Inmarsat and NAVTEX for the GMDSS operator licence.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 7R Restricted GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
aviation-maritime.blurb: Examination covering GMDSS operating practices limited to sea area A1, leading to the restricted GMDSS operator licence.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 8 Ship Radar Techniques
aviation-maritime.blurb: 50-question technical examination on radar theory, pulse circuits, magnetrons and alignment required for the radar endorsement.

aviation-maritime.name: FCC Element 9 GMDSS Radio Maintenance Practices and Procedures
aviation-maritime.blurb: 50-question examination on at-sea maintenance and repair of GMDSS equipment for the radio maintainer licence.

aviation-maritime.name: General Radiotelephone Operator License
aviation-maritime.blurb: Lifetime commercial licence earned by passing Elements 1 and 3, required to repair and maintain most ship and aircraft radio transmitters.

aviation-maritime.name: GMDSS Radio Maintainer's License
aviation-maritime.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1, 3 and 9 authorising at-sea maintenance and repair of Global Maritime Distress and Safety System equipment.

aviation-maritime.name: GMDSS Radio Operator's License
aviation-maritime.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7 authorising operation of GMDSS distress and safety communications equipment at sea.

aviation-maritime.name: GMDSS Radio Operator/Maintainer License
aviation-maritime.blurb: Combined licence covering both GMDSS operating and maintenance privileges, requiring Elements 1, 3, 7 and 9 to be passed.

aviation-maritime.name: Marine Radio Operator Permit
aviation-maritime.blurb: Permit obtained by passing Element 1, required to operate radiotelephone stations aboard many passenger and commercial vessels.

aviation-maritime.name: Radiotelegraph Operator License
aviation-maritime.blurb: Commercial licence requiring Elements 1, 5 and 6 plus Morse code proficiency for operating and maintaining radiotelegraph stations.

aviation-maritime.name: Restricted GMDSS Radio Operator License
aviation-maritime.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7R for GMDSS operation on vessels trading only within VHF coverage of coast stations.

aviation-maritime.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit
aviation-maritime.blurb: Lifetime permit issued without examination, commonly required by pilots flying internationally and by operators of certain radio stations.

aviation-maritime.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit Limited Use
aviation-maritime.blurb: Permit variant issued to aircraft pilots and other operators who do not qualify for the standard restricted permit.

aviation-maritime.name: Ship Radar Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Endorsement added to a GROL or radiotelegraph licence by passing Element 8, required to service shipboard radar systems.

aviation-maritime.name: Six Months Service Endorsement
aviation-maritime.blurb: Endorsement documenting six months of shipboard radio service, needed for certain sole radio operator positions at sea.

transportation.name: ATSSA Flagger Instructor Certification
transportation.blurb: Train-the-trainer certification qualifying holders to teach flagging procedures and work-zone signalling under the MUTCD to road crews.

transportation.name: ATSSA Traffic Control Supervisor Certification
transportation.blurb: Certification for personnel who plan, inspect and supervise temporary traffic control on highway work zones under MUTCD Part 6.

transportation.name: ATSSA Traffic Control Technician Certification
transportation.blurb: Entry-level work-zone credential covering device placement, taper lengths, channelising devices and flagging under federal MUTCD standards.

transportation.name: CDL Air Brakes Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Knowledge test on air brake components, inspection and emergency stopping required to remove the L restriction from a commercial licence.

transportation.name: CDL Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test
transportation.blurb: Closed-course examination of straight-line backing, offset backing, parallel parking and alley docking manoeuvres for commercial vehicles.

transportation.name: CDL Combination Vehicles Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Class A knowledge test covering coupling and uncoupling, trailer air lines, rollover prevention and combination vehicle inspection.

transportation.name: CDL Doubles and Triples Endorsement Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Endorsement test on pulling multiple trailers, converter dollies, crack-the-whip effects and coupling sequence for double and triple combinations.

transportation.name: CDL General Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Core written test taken by every commercial driver applicant, covering vehicle inspection, safe operating procedures, cargo and hours of service.

transportation.name: CDL Hazardous Materials Endorsement Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Endorsement test on placarding, shipping papers, loading rules and emergency response for drivers hauling regulated hazardous materials.

transportation.name: CDL On-Road Driving Skills Test
transportation.blurb: Examiner-scored drive covering turns, intersections, railway crossings, lane changes and hill operation in a representative commercial vehicle.

transportation.name: CDL Passenger Endorsement Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Knowledge test on passenger loading, standee lines, emergency exits and bus inspection required to carry 16 or more people.

transportation.name: CDL Pre-Trip Vehicle Inspection Test
transportation.blurb: Verbal walk-around examination in which the applicant identifies and explains inspection points on engine, brakes, coupling and trailer systems.

transportation.name: CDL School Bus Endorsement Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Endorsement test on danger zones, student loading and unloading, railway crossings and evacuation procedures for school bus drivers.

transportation.name: CDL Tank Vehicle Endorsement Knowledge Test
transportation.blurb: Endorsement test covering liquid surge, baffled and unbaffled tanks, outage and high centre of gravity handling for tank vehicles.

transportation.name: Certified Automotive Fleet Manager
transportation.blurb: Fleet management credential earned by passing eight discipline examinations spanning asset, financial, information, maintenance and risk management.

transportation.name: Certified Automotive Fleet Specialist
transportation.blurb: Intermediate fleet credential awarded after completing four of the eight CAFM discipline examinations covering core fleet operations topics.

transportation.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Class A CDL Theory Assessment
transportation.blurb: Federally mandated theory curriculum and 80 percent assessment that first-time Class A applicants must complete before taking the CDL skills test.

transportation.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Class B CDL Theory Assessment
transportation.blurb: Required theory instruction and assessment covering vehicle systems, safe operating procedures and non-driving activities for Class B applicants.

transportation.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Class B to Class A Upgrade Theory Assessment
transportation.blurb: Shortened federal theory curriculum for existing Class B holders upgrading to Class A, focused on combination vehicles and coupling.

transportation.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Hazardous Materials Endorsement Theory Assessment
transportation.blurb: Theory-only federal training requirement covering hazmat regulations and loading rules before a driver may take the H endorsement test.

transportation.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Passenger Endorsement Theory Assessment
transportation.blurb: Federal theory and behind-the-wheel curriculum required before a driver may obtain a passenger endorsement on a commercial licence.

transportation.name: Entry-Level Driver Training School Bus Endorsement Theory Assessment
transportation.blurb: Federally required theory and range training on student management, loading zones and evacuation before the school bus endorsement test.

transportation.name: IMSA Roadway Lighting Technician Certification
transportation.blurb: Certification for technicians installing and maintaining street and highway lighting circuits, luminaires, poles and photoelectric controls.

transportation.name: IMSA Traffic Signal Technician Certification
transportation.blurb: Tiered certification covering traffic signal construction, controllers, detection, conflict monitors and field maintenance of intersection equipment.

transportation.name: IMSA Work Zone Traffic Control Safety Certification
transportation.blurb: Certification on temporary traffic control zones, signing, channelising devices and flagger safety for municipal and utility road crews.

transportation.name: Motorcycle Safety Foundation Advanced RiderCourse
transportation.blurb: One-day course for licensed riders on cornering, braking drills, risk management and machine control using the rider own motorcycle.

transportation.name: Motorcycle Safety Foundation Basic RiderCourse
transportation.blurb: Entry-level rider training with classroom and range instruction; completion often waives the state motorcycle skills test for endorsement.

transportation.name: Motorcycle Safety Foundation RiderCoach Preparation Course
transportation.blurb: Instructor certification course preparing candidates to teach MSF curricula, including coaching technique, range management and evaluation.

transportation.name: NAPT Certified Director of Pupil Transportation
transportation.blurb: Credential for school transportation directors covering routing, fleet maintenance, special-needs transport, budgeting and driver supervision.

transportation.name: National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners Certification Test
transportation.blurb: Federal test qualifying clinicians to perform commercial driver physicals and issue medical examiner certificates under FMCSA standards.

transportation.name: National Safety Council Defensive Driving Course
transportation.blurb: Nationally recognised driver improvement course teaching collision avoidance, space management and hazard recognition for fleet and personal drivers.

transportation.name: TRAA National Driver Certification Program
transportation.blurb: Three-level towing certification covering light-duty, medium/heavy-duty and recovery operations with written and practical evaluations.

transportation.name: TSA Hazardous Materials Endorsement Threat Assessment
transportation.blurb: Federal fingerprint-based background check every commercial driver must clear before a state may issue a hazardous materials endorsement.

transportation.name: WreckMaster Towing and Recovery Certification
transportation.blurb: Graded towing and recovery certification covering rigging, winching, load calculation and rollover recovery for light through heavy-duty operators.

transportation.name: Certified Customs Specialist
transportation.blurb: Open-book certification on US import regulations, entry procedures, classification, valuation and trade agreements for customs professionals.

transportation.name: Certified Export Specialist
transportation.blurb: Certification covering the Export Administration Regulations, ITAR, licensing, denied party screening and export documentation.

transportation.name: Certified Global Business Professional
transportation.blurb: Exam-based credential covering global business management, market research, supply chain management and trade finance.

transportation.name: Certified Logistics Associate
transportation.blurb: Foundational supply chain credential covering the logistics environment, safety, quality, teamwork and workplace computer systems.

transportation.name: Certified Logistics Technician
transportation.blurb: Mid-level warehouse credential on receiving, storage, order processing, packaging, inventory control, dispatch and tracking operations.

transportation.name: Certified Transportation Broker
transportation.blurb: Examination for freight brokers covering broker-carrier agreements, liability, claims, credit management and federal brokerage regulation.

transportation.name: Certified Transportation Professional
transportation.blurb: Four-part examination for private fleet managers spanning equipment, operations, finance and human resource management.

transportation.name: Certified Zone Specialist
transportation.blurb: Certification on United States Foreign-Trade Zone operations, admission procedures, inventory control and zone compliance requirements.

transportation.name: NATMI Certified Director of Maintenance
transportation.blurb: Credential for fleet maintenance executives covering preventive maintenance programmes, shop management, budgeting and DOT compliance.

transportation.name: NATMI Certified Director of Safety
transportation.blurb: Certification for motor carrier safety directors covering FMCSA compliance, driver qualification files, accident investigation and CSA scores.

transportation.name: NATMI Certified Safety Supervisor
transportation.blurb: Entry-level trucking safety credential covering hours of service, drug and alcohol testing, cargo securement and driver coaching.

transportation.name: NATMI Certified Supervisor of Maintenance
transportation.blurb: Supervisory credential covering shop workflow, technician management, warranty recovery and vehicle inspection requirements.

transportation.name: Customs Broker License Examination
transportation.blurb: Federal 80-question open-book examination held twice a year that applicants must pass to become a licensed customs broker.

transportation.name: Export Compliance Professional Certification
transportation.blurb: Specialist certification in EAR or ITAR export controls, licensing, classification and enforcement for trade compliance staff.

transportation.name: FIATA Diploma in Freight Forwarding
transportation.blurb: Internationally recognised freight forwarding diploma covering multimodal transport, documentation, insurance and incoterms.

transportation.name: IATA Cargo Introductory Course
transportation.blurb: Foundation air cargo qualification covering air waybills, rating, cargo acceptance, handling procedures and IATA regulations.

transportation.name: IATA Air Cargo Security Awareness Training
transportation.blurb: Training on supply chain security, known consignor rules, screening methods and threat recognition for air cargo handling staff.

transportation.name: Master Customs Specialist
transportation.blurb: Advanced designation for CCS holders covering partner government agency requirements, enforcement actions and complex entry issues.

transportation.name: Master Export Specialist
transportation.blurb: Advanced export designation building on the CES and covering sanctions, licensing strategy and export enforcement in depth.

transportation.name: IATA Airport Operations Fundamentals
transportation.blurb: Course and assessment covering airside operations, ground handling, turnaround coordination, capacity planning and airport safety management.

transportation.name: FRA Blue Signal Protection Training
transportation.blurb: Training under 49 CFR Part 218 on blue signal display and removal protecting workers servicing rolling equipment.

transportation.name: FRA Conductor Certification
transportation.blurb: Federally required certification of freight and passenger conductors covering rules knowledge, skills testing and monitoring under Part 242.

transportation.name: FRA Locomotive Engineer Certification
transportation.blurb: Certification required to operate a locomotive, involving written examination, skills performance testing and periodic operational monitoring.

transportation.name: FRA Part 243 Safety-Related Railroad Employee Training
transportation.blurb: Federal rule requiring railroads and contractors to qualify safety-related employees through approved training programmes and testing.

transportation.name: FRA Roadway Worker Protection Training
transportation.blurb: Annual training under Part 214 on on-track safety, working limits, train approach warning and job briefings for roadway workers.

transportation.name: FRA Track Inspector Qualification
transportation.blurb: Qualification under the Track Safety Standards allowing an individual to inspect track, classify defects and authorise remedial action.

transportation.name: National Transit Institute Roadway Worker Protection Training
transportation.blurb: Rail transit training on right-of-way access, protection methods and hazard recognition for wayside workers and contractors.

transportation.name: Public Transportation Safety Certification Training Program

list.name: Chief Engineer (Limited) Endorsement
list.blurb: Engineering licence for chief engineers on vessels of limited horsepower and tonnage, tested on motor and steam plant operation.

list.name: Chief Mate Endorsement
list.blurb: Senior deck licence for vessels of any gross tons, requiring management-level STCW training plus extensive Coast Guard examination modules.

list.name: Company Security Officer Course
list.blurb: Approved course preparing shoreside personnel to develop and maintain vessel security plans under the ISPS Code and MTSA.

list.name: Designated Duty Engineer Endorsement
list.blurb: Engineering licence for sole-engineer vessels, issued in horsepower tiers and requiring exams on diesel plants, electrical and auxiliary systems.

list.name: Facility Security Officer Course
list.blurb: Training required for officers responsible for security plans, drills and access control at MTSA-regulated waterfront facilities.

list.name: First Class Pilot Endorsement
list.blurb: Route-specific federal pilotage endorsement earned by round trips over the route and a chart examination drawn from memory.

list.name: Lifeboatman Endorsement
list.blurb: Rating endorsement requiring practical assessment in launching and handling survival craft, matched by the STCW proficiency in survival craft.

list.name: Marine Chemist Certification
list.blurb: Certification allowing a chemist to issue safe-for-workers and safe-for-hot-work certificates on vessels under NFPA 306.

list.name: Master of Vessels 1600 Gross Tons
list.blurb: Deck licence for oceans, near coastal or inland service on vessels up to 1600 gross tons, requiring multi-module Coast Guard examinations.

list.name: Master of Vessels 500 Gross Tons
list.blurb: Mid-tier deck licence for vessels up to 500 gross tons covering navigation, stability, cargo handling and rules of the road.

list.name: Master of Vessels Any Gross Tons
list.blurb: Highest deck licence authorising command of vessels of unlimited tonnage on oceans, subject to management-level STCW and extensive exams.

list.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 100 GRT
list.blurb: Widely held captain licence for inspected passenger vessels under 100 gross tons, tested on deck general, deck safety, rules and chart plot.

list.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
list.blurb: Deck licence for vessels under 200 gross tons requiring additional sea service and examination beyond the 100 ton master level.

list.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 25 GRT
list.blurb: Entry master licence assigned when a mariner qualifying sea service is on vessels of very small tonnage under 46 CFR 11.422.

list.name: Master of Vessels Less Than 50 GRT
list.blurb: Master licence tier assigned from documented tonnage history, authorising command of inspected vessels under 50 gross tons.

list.name: Master of Towing Vessels
list.blurb: Licence to command towing vessels on a specified route, earned through a towing officer assessment record and Coast Guard examination.

list.name: Mate (Pilot) of Towing Vessels
list.blurb: Wheelhouse licence permitting a mariner to stand a navigation watch aboard towing vessels after completing assessed towing competencies.

list.name: Mate of Vessels Less Than 200 GRT
list.blurb: Deck licence authorising watchkeeping as mate on inspected vessels under 200 gross tons on inland or near coastal routes.

list.name: Merchant Mariner Credential
list.blurb: Single credential book that consolidates all officer, rating and STCW endorsements a United States mariner holds.

list.name: Merchant Mariner Medical Certificate
list.blurb: Medical and physical fitness certificate required alongside the merchant mariner credential, based on the CG-719K examination.

list.name: NAMS Certified Marine Surveyor
list.blurb: Peer-reviewed surveyor credential requiring documented experience, sample surveys and examination in yachts, cargo or hull and machinery.

list.name: NASBLA-Approved Boating Safety Course
list.blurb: Nationally approved recreational boating course covering navigation rules, required equipment and emergencies, accepted by most states.

list.name: NMEA 2000 Network Installer Certification
list.blurb: Certification on designing, wiring and troubleshooting NMEA 2000 backbone networks for marine navigation and engine data.

list.name: NMEA Marine Electronics Installer Certification
list.blurb: Tiered certification for technicians installing radar, chartplotters, autopilots, VHF and interfaced navigation electronics on vessels.

list.name: Operator of Uninspected Passenger Vessels
list.blurb: Entry captain licence allowing carriage of up to six paying passengers on uninspected vessels for inland, Great Lakes or near coastal routes.

list.name: Ordinary Seaman Endorsement
list.blurb: Entry-level deck rating requiring no sea service, used as the starting endorsement for new mariners joining a vessel crew.

list.name: Qualified Member of the Engine Department
list.blurb: Engine rating covering oiler, fireman-watertender, junior engineer and refrigerating engineer roles, earned by sea service and examination.

list.name: Radar Observer (Inland) Certification
list.blurb: Short course and practical assessment on radar navigation and collision avoidance for inland and river route mariners.

list.name: Radar Observer (Unlimited) Certification
list.blurb: Approved course covering radar plotting, relative motion, ARPA principles and collision avoidance for unlimited tonnage service.

list.name: Rating Forming Part of an Engineering Watch
list.blurb: STCW engine rating certifying competence to keep an engine room watch under the direction of a licensed engineer officer.

list.name: Rating Forming Part of a Navigational Watch
list.blurb: STCW deck rating requiring assessed steering, lookout and watchkeeping competencies for service on seagoing vessels.

list.name: SAMS Accredited Marine Surveyor
list.blurb: Accreditation for marine surveyors requiring experience, continuing education and an examination on survey practice and standards.

list.name: Second Mate Endorsement
list.blurb: Unlimited-tonnage deck licence above third mate, requiring additional sea service and Coast Guard examination modules.

list.name: Ship's Cook Endorsement
list.blurb: Steward department endorsement requiring approved food safety training and sea service before a mariner may serve as ship cook.

list.name: STCW Advanced Firefighting
list.blurb: Approved course on shipboard fire command, fixed systems, fire investigation and casualty control required for officer endorsements.

list.name: STCW Automatic Radar Plotting Aids
list.blurb: Approved course on ARPA target acquisition, trial manoeuvres, system limitations and errors for officers in charge of a navigational watch.

list.name: STCW Basic Training
list.blurb: Four-module STCW course covering personal survival, basic firefighting, elementary first aid and personal safety and social responsibility.

list.name: STCW Bridge Resource Management
list.blurb: Approved course on bridge teamwork, situational awareness, communication and error management for watchkeeping deck officers.

list.name: STCW Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems
list.blurb: Approved course on electronic chart systems, route planning, alarms, sensor inputs and ECDIS limitations for navigating officers.

list.name: STCW Leadership and Managerial Skills
list.blurb: Management-level STCW course on shipboard leadership, resource management, decision making and workload assessment.

list.name: STCW Leadership and Teamwork
list.blurb: Operational-level STCW course on teamwork, task allocation and effective communication aboard vessels for junior officers.

list.name: STCW Medical Care Provider
list.blurb: Advanced shipboard medical course covering patient assessment, medication administration and radio medical advice for masters and mates.

list.name: STCW Medical First Aid Provider
list.blurb: Approved course on immediate care of shipboard casualties including bleeding, burns, fractures, hypothermia and rescue breathing.

list.name: Tankerman-Assistant Endorsement
list.blurb: Endorsement allowing a mariner to assist in cargo transfers of oil or hazardous liquids under the supervision of a person in charge.

list.name: Tankerman-Engineer Endorsement
list.blurb: Endorsement for licensed engineers supervising transfer of fuel oil and bunkering operations aboard tank vessels.

list.name: Tankerman-PIC Endorsement
list.blurb: Endorsement authorising a mariner to act as person in charge of transferring dangerous liquid or liquefied gas cargo.

list.name: Tankerman-PIC (Barge) Endorsement
list.blurb: Restricted tankerman endorsement covering cargo transfers on tank barges rather than self-propelled tank vessels.

list.name: Third Assistant Engineer Endorsement
list.blurb: Entry unlimited engineering officer licence requiring extensive Coast Guard examinations in motor, steam, gas turbine and electrical plants.

list.name: Third Mate Endorsement
list.blurb: Entry unlimited deck officer licence for oceans service, examined across navigation, stability, cargo, safety and rules of the road.

list.name: Transportation Worker Identification Credential
list.blurb: Biometric identity card required for unescorted access to secure port areas and for all credentialed merchant mariners.

list.name: USCG Chart Plot Exam Module
list.blurb: Ten-question plotting module requiring 90 percent to pass, covering fixes, set and drift, courses to steer and estimated times of arrival.

list.name: USCG Deck General Exam Module
list.blurb: Examination module on seamanship, marlinespike, ship construction, stability and deck operations for master level credentials.

list.name: USCG Deck Safety Exam Module
list.blurb: Examination module covering firefighting, damage control, lifesaving equipment, pollution regulations and emergency procedures.

list.name: USCG Navigation General Exam Module
list.blurb: Fifty-question module on aids to navigation, tides and currents, compass error, weather and publications, requiring 90 percent to pass.

list.name: USCG Rules of the Road Exam Module
list.blurb: Module on International and Inland navigation rules, lights, shapes and sound signals requiring a 90 percent passing score.

list.name: Vessel Personnel with Designated Security Duties
list.blurb: STCW security training for crew assigned security tasks, covering threat recognition, screening, search and security equipment use.

list.name: Vessel Security Officer Course
list.blurb: Approved course for officers responsible for implementing and maintaining the ship security plan under the ISPS Code.

list.name: Amateur Extra Class License Exam
list.blurb: 50-question examination granting full amateur radio privileges, covering advanced theory, transmission lines and specialised operating rules.

list.name: Amateur Radio General Class License Exam
list.blurb: 35-question examination opening most high-frequency amateur bands, covering propagation, antennas, rules and station operation.

list.name: Amateur Radio Technician Class License Exam
list.blurb: Entry amateur radio examination of 35 questions on regulations, operating practice and electronics for VHF and UHF privileges.

list.name: FCC Element 1 Basic Radio Law and Operating Practice
list.blurb: 24-question examination on radio law and operating practice that underpins the Marine Radio Operator Permit and other commercial licences.

list.name: FCC Element 3 General Radiotelephone
list.blurb: 76-question technical examination on electronics, antennas and transmitters taken with Element 1 to earn the GROL.

list.name: FCC Element 5 Radiotelegraph Operating Practice
list.blurb: Written examination on radiotelegraph operating procedures and regulations required toward the Radiotelegraph Operator License.

list.name: FCC Element 6 Advanced Radiotelegraph
list.blurb: Technical examination on radiotelegraph equipment, installation and maintenance for the commercial radiotelegraph operator licence.

list.name: FCC Element 7 GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
list.blurb: 76-question examination on distress alerting, digital selective calling, Inmarsat and NAVTEX for the GMDSS operator licence.

list.name: FCC Element 7R Restricted GMDSS Radio Operating Practices
list.blurb: Examination covering GMDSS operating practices limited to sea area A1, leading to the restricted GMDSS operator licence.

list.name: FCC Element 8 Ship Radar Techniques
list.blurb: 50-question technical examination on radar theory, pulse circuits, magnetrons and alignment required for the radar endorsement.

list.name: FCC Element 9 GMDSS Radio Maintenance Practices and Procedures
list.blurb: 50-question examination on at-sea maintenance and repair of GMDSS equipment for the radio maintainer licence.

list.name: General Radiotelephone Operator License
list.blurb: Lifetime commercial licence earned by passing Elements 1 and 3, required to repair and maintain most ship and aircraft radio transmitters.

list.name: GMDSS Radio Maintainer's License
list.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1, 3 and 9 authorising at-sea maintenance and repair of Global Maritime Distress and Safety System equipment.

list.name: GMDSS Radio Operator's License
list.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7 authorising operation of GMDSS distress and safety communications equipment at sea.

list.name: GMDSS Radio Operator/Maintainer License
list.blurb: Combined licence covering both GMDSS operating and maintenance privileges, requiring Elements 1, 3, 7 and 9 to be passed.

list.name: Marine Radio Operator Permit
list.blurb: Permit obtained by passing Element 1, required to operate radiotelephone stations aboard many passenger and commercial vessels.

list.name: Radiotelegraph Operator License
list.blurb: Commercial licence requiring Elements 1, 5 and 6 plus Morse code proficiency for operating and maintaining radiotelegraph stations.

list.name: Restricted GMDSS Radio Operator License
list.blurb: Licence earned through Elements 1 and 7R for GMDSS operation on vessels trading only within VHF coverage of coast stations.

list.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit
list.blurb: Lifetime permit issued without examination, commonly required by pilots flying internationally and by operators of certain radio stations.

list.name: Restricted Radiotelephone Operator Permit Limited Use
list.blurb: Permit variant issued to aircraft pilots and other operators who do not qualify for the standard restricted permit.

list.name: Ship Radar Endorsement
list.blurb: Endorsement added to a GROL or radiotelegraph licence by passing Element 8, required to service shipboard radar systems.

list.name: Six Months Service Endorsement
list.blurb: Endorsement documenting six months of shipboard radio service, needed for certain sole radio operator positions at sea.

list.name: FRA Blue Signal Protection Training
list.blurb: Training under 49 CFR Part 218 on blue signal display and removal protecting workers servicing rolling equipment.

list.name: FRA Conductor Certification
list.blurb: Federally required certification of freight and passenger conductors covering rules knowledge, skills testing and monitoring under Part 242.

list.name: FRA Locomotive Engineer Certification
list.blurb: Certification required to operate a locomotive, involving written examination, skills performance testing and periodic operational monitoring.

list.name: FRA Part 243 Safety-Related Railroad Employee Training
list.blurb: Federal rule requiring railroads and contractors to qualify safety-related employees through approved training programmes and testing.

list.name: FRA Roadway Worker Protection Training
list.blurb: Annual training under Part 214 on on-track safety, working limits, train approach warning and job briefings for roadway workers.

list.name: FRA Track Inspector Qualification
list.blurb: Qualification under the Track Safety Standards allowing an individual to inspect track, classify defects and authorise remedial action.

list.name: National Transit Institute Roadway Worker Protection Training
list.blurb: Rail transit training on right-of-way access, protection methods and hazard recognition for wayside workers and contractors.

list.name: Public Transportation Safety Certification Training Program
list.blurb: Federally mandated curriculum for state safety oversight staff and rail transit agency personnel with safety oversight responsibilities.

list.name: Roadway Worker in Charge Qualification
list.blurb: Qualification allowing a worker to establish and control on-track working limits and conduct job briefings for a roadway work group.

list.name: Transit Safety and Security Program Certificate
list.blurb: USDOT certificate programme for transit safety professionals covering system safety, security planning, emergency management and audits.
